summary: OIO Group files Form 6-K disclosing a third closing under a previously entered Private Placement Share Purchase Agreement. The company issued 750,000 ordinary shares at US$0.80 per share for gross proceeds of $600,000. The offering is exempt under Section 4(a)(2). This is an ongoing equity drawdown facility, not a special situation; it is a routine capital raise. No change of control, strategic review, or extraordinary corporate event is announced.
